items.t: An official District neighbourhood or planning-area name "Canterbury" is NOT CONFIRMED — the name does not appear as a named neighbourhood in the District's Official Community Plan, Bylaw No. 4985, 2018, whose commercial structure is the Ambleside Municipal Town Centre, the Park Royal regional shopping centre, and the village centres of Dundarave, Caulfeild Village and Horseshoe Bay; in District planning terms this hillside sits inside the wider British Properties residential area. Street-by-street boundaries are UNVERIFIED.

Nearby areas: Chartwell (east, also British Properties), Ambleside (south, below the highway), Westcot / the lower British Properties (west), Sentinel Hill (south-west) and the upper British Properties benches (north). Taylor Way is the hillside's main connection between Marine Drive and Highway 1; the Lions Gate Bridge is the fixed crossing to Vancouver.

Transit anchors: TransLink's system map shows the British Properties served by West Vancouver Blue Bus routes from Park Royal Exchange, including route 254 (British Properties), with route 250 on Marine Drive below the hillside running between Horseshoe Bay, Dundarave, Park Royal and downtown Vancouver via the Lions Gate Bridge. There is no transit node and no condo node inside Canterbury.

There is no park confirmed inside Canterbury.
The covenant question is title-by-title, not a neighbourhood answer.

Hollyburn Country Club and Capilano Golf and Country Club are the British Properties-area private clubs buyers associate with this hillside, but no membership, address or facility fact for either was verified on an official or club source in the research pass — treat any claim about them as UNCONFIRMED.

blocks.text: Townhome complexes in Canterbury
Streets, schools and getting around Canterbury

items.t: Where the townhouse stock concentrates: nowhere inside Canterbury — there is none. West Vancouver's attached stock concentrates downhill in Ambleside and the village centres, outside this hillside enclave. The confirmed services are likewise downhill: Park Royal and Ambleside on Marine Drive, the West Vancouver Community Centre and Aquatic Centre at 2121 Marine Drive, and the West Vancouver Memorial Library at 1950 Marine Drive.

Market numbers: West Vancouver is outside SnapStats coverage in Jared's reports — coverage is Surrey, S Surrey White Rock, Cloverdale, Langley, North Delta, Abbotsford, Mission, Burnaby, Coquitlam, Port Coquitlam, Port Moody, New Westminster, Pitt Meadows and Maple Ridge only. All market figures for Canterbury: UNVERIFIED.

Transit: TransLink's North & West Vancouver system map (September 2026) shows the British Properties served by West Vancouver Blue Bus routes from Park Royal Exchange, including route 254 (British Properties) on the properties' road network, and route 250 on Marine Drive below the hillside between Horseshoe Bay, Dundarave, Park Royal and downtown Vancouver via the Lions Gate Bridge.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect townhome buyers in Canterbury

items.t: District zoning and plan — standing corrections applied: houses sit in the RS single-family dwelling zones of Zoning Bylaw No. 4662, 2010 (never White Rock's bylaws — the 2506/2220 pair belongs to White Rock only); Section 200 states minimum site areas of 8,094 m² in RS1, 1,625 m² in RS2, 975 m² in RS3, 731 m² in RS4 and 488 m² in RS5, with RS6 using the area of the site of record, and lists secondary suites and a detached secondary suite among permitted uses. The District-wide plan is the Official Community Plan, Bylaw No. 4985, 2018; a Canterbury-specific local area plan is UNVERIFIED (none confirmed).

SSMUH, stated as the Province states it: provincial SSMUH legislation requires zoning to allow a minimum of 4 dwelling units on single-family and duplex parcels greater than 280 m², and a minimum of 6 units on such parcels greater than 280 m² near frequent bus service. West Vancouver's local implementing-bylaw status: UNVERIFIED — no District source confirming the adoption state was read in the research pass. Separately, on July 21, 2025 the Province directed West Vancouver to amend its OCP to provide increased density in the single-family and duplex areas adjacent to Ambleside and Dundarave (and at Park Royal–Taylor Way) by December 31, 2025 — whether Canterbury's lowest streets fall inside the "adjacent" areas must be verified per property.

blocks.text: Good to know about Canterbury

items.t: Canterbury's name is a board and marketing name, not a District one. The District's OCP plans this hillside as part of the wider British Properties residential area between the Ambleside Municipal Town Centre and the upper benches — a buyer searching District documents for "Canterbury" will find nothing, which is a naming gap, not a missing neighbourhood.

The Province has already directed more density beside this hillside. On July 21, 2025, the Province directed West Vancouver to amend its OCP for increased density in the single-family and duplex areas adjacent to Ambleside and Dundarave (and at Park Royal–Taylor Way) by December 31, 2025. Whether Canterbury's lowest streets are "adjacent" is a per-property check, not a sub-area answer.

Half the tax bill leaves the District. Approximately 50% of a West Vancouver tax bill is collected by the District and remitted to other taxing authorities, and District water and sewer are metered and billed quarterly — a different billing rhythm from the flat annual notices buyers meet elsewhere.

The District counted 44,122 people in 2021. West Vancouver's 2021 Census population was 44,122 (Statistics Canada, 2021 Census Profile) — context for a hillside enclave whose services all sit in the Ambleside town centre below it.

blocks.text: Lots and land in Canterbury
Fee-simple lots

items.t: Established-street house lots: detached houses on hillside lots in the RS single-family dwelling zones of Zoning Bylaw No. The British Properties streets are the historic subdivision fabric — built lot fabric, not a lot offering.

Lot character, as the bylaw states it: Section 200 minimum site areas are 8,094 m² in RS1, 1,625 m² in RS2, 975 m² in RS3, 731 m² in RS4 and 488 m² in RS5, with RS6 using the area of the site of record; the larger RS1/RS2 minimums are the ones associated with the British Properties benches. These are zone minimums, not a claim about any existing lot's size; the zone for a specific lot is shown on the District's Zoning Map. Secondary suites and a detached secondary suite are among the permitted uses in the single-family zones.

Serviced position: West Vancouver water and sewer utilities are metered and billed quarterly by the District — Canterbury's established lots sit inside that District system on the District's wording. Septic or well servicing by street: UNVERIFIED in the research; confirm the specific parcel with the District.

ALR vs non-ALR: no ALR parcel in Canterbury is documented in the research; parcel-level ALR status is listed UNVERIFIED there. No ALR percentage split is stated — check any specific parcel on Agricultural Land Commission mapping.
Park Royal — stated precisely, and outside this area: Park Royal sits downhill at Marine Drive and Taylor Way. Its tenure split — District of West Vancouver land versus Capilano IR No.

blocks.text: Streets, schools and getting around Canterbury

items.t: Roads: Taylor Way is the hillside's main connection between Marine Drive and Highway 1; the Lions Gate Bridge is the fixed crossing to Vancouver, reached via Marine Drive. Transit: West Vancouver Blue Bus route 254 (British Properties) serves the properties' road network from Park Royal Exchange, and route 250 runs on Marine Drive below the hillside between Horseshoe Bay, Dundarave, Park Royal and downtown Vancouver via the Lions Gate Bridge. Commute times in minutes: UNVERIFIED.

Services are downhill: Park Royal, at Marine Drive and Taylor Way, is recognized in the OCP as the regional shopping centre and Ambleside is the Municipal Town Centre; the West Vancouver Community Centre and Aquatic Centre is at 2121 Marine Drive and West Vancouver Memorial Library at 1950 Marine Drive, both in Ambleside. Shopping or grocery inside Canterbury itself: UNVERIFIED (none confirmed). Nearest hospital: Lions Gate Hospital, 231 East 15th Street, North Vancouver.

Schools: SD45 catchments are address-based and SD45 directs families to the school locator on its admissions page; no sample address inside Canterbury could be taken from an official source, so every Canterbury catchment is UNVERIFIED — check each address in the locator. The nearby British Properties schools are Chartwell Elementary (K–7), 1300 Chartwell Drive, Sentinel Secondary (8–12), 1250 Chartwell Drive, and Westcot Elementary (K–7), 760 Westcot Road. SD45 has no middle-school tier (K–7 elementary, 8–12 secondary).

blocks.text: Local rules that affect land buyers in Canterbury

items.t: Zoning — District of West Vancouver Zoning Bylaw No. 4662, 2010: houses sit in the RS single-family dwelling zones. The White Rock pair (Zoning 2506 / OCP 2220) belongs to White Rock ONLY and never applies here. Confirm the parcel's zone on the District's Zoning Map.
OCP — District of West Vancouver Official Community Plan, Bylaw No. 4985, 2018: the District-wide plan covering Canterbury; a Canterbury-specific local area plan is UNVERIFIED (none confirmed).

SSMUH / added units, as the Province states it: provincial SSMUH legislation requires zoning to allow a minimum of 4 dwelling units on single-family and duplex parcels greater than 280 m², and a minimum of 6 units on such parcels greater than 280 m² near frequent bus service (a route stopping at least every 15 minutes on average). West Vancouver's local implementing-bylaw status: UNVERIFIED — no District source confirming the adoption state was read.

Hazard development permits (District frame): an Environmental Development Permit is required for work within 15 metres of the top of any watercourse bank; a Wildfire Hazard Development Permit is required for work within the Wildfire Hazard Development Permit Area, described as within 100 metres of an undisturbed forest interface; a Foreshore Development Permit applies within the Foreshore Development Permit Area (waterfront / coastal-flood-risk property), which does not ordinarily reach this upper hillside. Both the wildfire and environmental frames can apply on Canterbury's hillside and creek lots.

ALR rules (for completeness — no Canterbury ALR parcel is confirmed here): subdivision within the ALR requires ALC approval; ALR residences cannot be stratified (ALC Bulletin 09 s. 6; Strata Property Act s. 239; Agricultural Land Commission Act s. 21(1)); ALC residence caps: principal ≤500 m², suite within the principal residence only, additional residence 90 m² (≤40 ha) / 186 m² (>40 ha). Farm class is three-tiered ($2,500 on 0.8–4 ha; $2,500 + 5% of the land's value over 4 ha; $10,000 under 0.8 ha; applications by October 31) — a flat "$2,500+" line is an ERROR.

Additional school tax (live at British Properties price points): 0.2% on the residential portion of assessed value between $3 million and $4 million and 0.4% on the portion above $4 million for 2026, rising to 0.3% and 0.6% on January 1, 2027.

District property taxes: District of West Vancouver 2026 property taxes were due July 2, 2026, with a 5% penalty on unpaid current taxes on July 2, 2026 and a further 5% on outstanding current taxes on September 2, 2026; approximately 50% of the tax bill is collected by the District and remitted to other taxing authorities.

blocks.text: Good to know about Canterbury

items.t: "Canterbury" is a page name, not a District planning name (2026-11-01 research): the District's OCP names Ambleside as the Municipal Town Centre, Park Royal as the regional shopping centre, and Dundarave, Caulfeild Village and Horseshoe Bay as village centres — searches, legal documents and District answers run on "British Properties" and the street address, not on "Canterbury."

The Province has already directed more density beside this hillside (July 21, 2025): West Vancouver was directed to amend its OCP for increased density in the single-family and duplex areas adjacent to Ambleside and Dundarave (and at Park Royal–Taylor Way) by December 31, 2025 — a lowest-street Canterbury lot's future density is a per-property check against that direction, not a sub-area answer.

Half the tax bill is not the District's: approximately 50% of a West Vancouver property tax bill is collected by the District and remitted to other taxing authorities — the District's own increase is only part of the year-over-year change a land buyer sees.

The waterfront below the hillside is a 1967 centennial build: the Centennial Seawalk runs roughly 1.7 km east from Dundarave Park to Ambleside, below Canterbury — view-and-access value for hillside lots, not lot area.

faq.a: The District of West Vancouver, on the British Properties side of the District above Ambleside; District-wide land use is guided by the Official Community Plan, Bylaw No. 4985, 2018.

faq.q: Which buses serve the British Properties above Ambleside?
faq.a: TransLink's system map shows Blue Bus route 254 (British Properties) serving the properties from Park Royal Exchange, with route 250 on Marine Drive below the hillside running between Horseshoe Bay, Dundarave, Park Royal and downtown Vancouver via the Lions Gate Bridge.

faq.q: Can Jared show me homes in Canterbury?
faq.a: Yes. Jared Gibbons, REALTOR® with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, books private showings across the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver. Call or text 604-928-1361, or use the contact form on this site.

faq.q: How do I find out what my home in Canterbury is worth?
faq.a: Jared prepares a home evaluation from recent comparable sales and the condition of your home. Contact him on 604-928-1361 or through the form on this site to arrange one.

faq.q: Are there any condos for sale in Canterbury itself?
faq.a: A "condo" search result carrying a Canterbury label should be checked for whether the property is actually in Ambleside, below the highway.

faq.q: Where is the nearest real condo stock?
faq.a: Canterbury itself has no condo node.

faq.q: Is Canterbury even an official neighbourhood name?
faq.a: 4985, 2018, and street-by-street boundaries are UNVERIFIED — the District plans this hillside as part of the wider British Properties.

faq.q: Can I buy a suite or coach house separately in Canterbury?
faq.a: No. Secondary suites and detached secondary suites are permitted uses in the RS zones, but they are accessory to the detached lot — they are not separate strata lots and cannot be bought on their own title.

faq.q: If I buy a condo in Ambleside instead, can the strata ban rentals?
faq.a: Not for a long-term tenancy — rental-restriction bylaws have been unenforceable since November 24, 2022 anywhere in BC, whatever a building directory still shows. A short-term rental bylaw can still bind, and a 55+ age bylaw can still limit who may live in the unit.

faq.q: Are there any townhouses in Canterbury?
faq.a: Canterbury's stock is detached houses in the RS zones; a townhouse buyer is shopping downhill in Ambleside or the village centres.

faq.q: A profile said the British Properties has "luxury townhomes" — where are they?
faq.a: That wording describes the wider British Properties / Upper West Vancouver area and names no complex inside Canterbury. For Canterbury specifically the complex is UNCONFIRMED — do not let area marketing stand in for a Canterbury address.

NOT CONFIRMED — the name does not appear as a named neighbourhood in the District's OCP (Bylaw No. 4985, 2018), and no District source publishes street-by-street boundaries for it. Buyers who cannot find the name search "British Properties" and "Chartwell" instead.
